title: Evidence for the R4 flip's preconditions
description: What r4_preconditions.ts can't check itself. Each key is the id of a check it prints (1, 2a, 2b-stage-r4, 2c-enforce, 2c-project, 3, 3b, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8); an entry turns that check from manual or pending into pass, never a failed one. r4_preconditions.ts fails on an entry for an id it doesn't make.
